issues.detail: The Hebrew text says 'בְּעֵבֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן' (beyond the Jordan), but the Chinese adds '以巴衛的' (of the Abarim?) before '約旦河' (Jordan). '以巴衛' is not in the Hebrew; it appears to be an addition or a misplacement of a name (possibly 'Abarim' or similar), changing the location description.
